## Recent Event Recaps

### INSPIRE 2024 Workshop Recap

Our most recent major event was the INSPIRE 2024 Conference workshop, where California Learning Lab grantees came together to collaborate on data science education initiatives. [Read the full recap](../posts/2023-10-20-inspire-2024-workshop-recap.qmd) for details about:

- Data science curriculum development discussions
- Cross-institutional collaboration strategies
- Assessment and evaluation frameworks
- Shared teaching materials and resources
